  WHY: With `git push --repo owner/repo feature/x`, the guard gets no refspec and checks only the current branch, so a push from `main` to `feature/x` can proceed without that branch's merged-PR check.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:481-486 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=[5]

  WHY: The template drops the actual refspec when `--repo` supplies the remote; the test enforces byte-for-byte parity.
- changelog.d/6215-heal-evidence-run-provenance.md and changelog.d/6055-heal-evidence-bundle.md | severity=NIT | confidence=[3]
